Leukocytes are not present in this field for assessment of inclusions. Findings demonstrate large/giant platelets, which can cause automated analyzers to under-count platelets (pseudothrombocytopenia); correlation with a smear-based platelet estimate is recommended.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a dense round nucleus with a rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas a giant platelet has no nucleus and shows purple granules within a pale gray-blue hyalomere.
MYH9 disorders show giant platelets together with Döhle-like blue inclusions in neutrophils, which need to be sought in leukocytes on the smear.
BSS shows giant platelets with true thrombocytopenia and absent ristocetin agglutination/CD42b expression, whereas this case had a normal manual count.
Clumps are aggregates of many normal-sized platelets, usually at the feathered edge, rather than single enlarged platelets.

61474.recognize_zh: 四格血片中多顆淋巴樣細胞周圍緊密環繞著一圈紫色血小板（血小板衛星現象），連脫落的淡藍色細胞質碎片（C、D 圖）也被血小板包圍，而旁邊的中性球則沒有，說明這是黏附在腫瘤淋巴細胞上的假性血小板減少。
features: Platelets rosetting tightly around the surface of lymphoid cells (panels A-C), forming satellitism
Platelet rosettes also surround detached pale blue cytoplasmic fragments without nuclei (panels C and D)
Lymphoid cells medium-to-large with round to oval nuclei, fairly condensed chromatin and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm
Adjacent segmented neutrophil (panel B) and other leukocytes lack attached platelets
Few free platelets in the background, explaining a spuriously low automated platelet count
61474.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, condensed chromatin and a moderate amount of pale basophilic cytoplasm. Numerous platelets adhere tightly around these lymphoid cells (platelet satellitism), and similar platelet rosettes surround detached anucleate cytoplasmic fragments derived from the neoplastic cells. A neighboring neutrophil lacks adherent platelets, and free platelets are sparse in the background. Findings represent platelet satellitism around neoplastic lymphocytes and their cytoplasmic fragments, a cause of pseudothrombocytopenia; platelet count should be verified by smear review or a citrated sample.

ddx.vs: Classic EDTA satellitism rosettes around neutrophils, whereas here platelets adhere to lymphoid cells and their fragments while the neutrophil is spared.
Clumping forms free platelet aggregates not centered on a leukocyte, whereas satellitism rings a cell or fragment.
Azurophilic or basophilic granules lie within the cell cytoplasm, while satellite platelets sit on the outer cell membrane as separate discrete particles.

ddx.dx: True thrombocytopenia with circulating lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia persists on a citrated sample and smear shows no platelets sequestered around cells.

61410.recognize_zh: CD20 染色低倍（40x）可見大型、彼此融合的結節被纖維帶分隔，結節內幾乎所有細胞陽性；高倍（400x）為大細胞強烈膜狀陽性，符合 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤常見的結節/濾泡樣生長與 B 細胞表型。
features: Low power (40x): large, expansile, back-to-back nodules separated by fibrous bands
Nodules composed almost entirely of CD20-positive cells; interfollicular/septal areas contain scattered positive cells
High power (400x): diffuse strong, complete membranous CD20 staining in medium to large cells
Cells tightly packed with little intervening stroma except small vessels
61410.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry at low power highlights large, confluent nodules separated by fibrous septa, with virtually all cells within the nodules positive. At high power, the neoplastic medium to large cells show strong, complete membranous CD20 staining. The nodular (follicular-like) pattern with sheets of CD20-positive large cells, in the appropriate context of strong MUM1/IRF4 expression and IRF4 rearrangement, is consistent with large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma, grade 3B / pediatric-type follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Pediatric-type FL lacks strong MUM1 and IRF4 rearrangement, and FL3B lacks IRF4 breaks; CD20 alone cannot separate them, requiring MUM1 IHC and IRF4 FISH.
Reactive follicles have polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages, intact mantle zones and BCL2-negative germinal center cells rather than confluent CD20+ large-cell nodules.
DLBCL NOS in adults usually grows diffusely and lacks IRF4 rearrangement, which is detected only by FISH.

61346.recognize_zh: 單調一致的中型淋巴瘤細胞密集成片，核圓並有數個小核仁，其間散佈含凋亡碎片的易染體巨噬細胞（tingible body macrophages），形成「星空」樣（starry sky），符合 Burkitt 淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells (nuclei similar in size to histiocyte nuclei)
Round nuclei with finely clumped chromatin and multiple small, often paracentral nucleoli
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with cells molding against each other
Scattered tingible body macrophages with clear cytoplasm containing apoptotic nuclear debris (starry sky pattern)
Frequent apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures
61346.describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely clumped chromatin, multiple small nucleoli and scant amphophilic cytoplasm. Numerous tingible body macrophages containing apoptotic debris impart a starry-sky appearance, with frequent mitoses and apoptotic bodies. Findings are suggestive of Burkitt lymphoma; confirmation requires a germinal center B-cell phenotype (CD20+, CD10+, BCL6+, BCL2 negative), Ki-67 near 100% and demonstration of MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Cells are more pleomorphic and larger with variable BCL2 expression and Ki-67 below 95%, and FISH shows BCL2 rearrangement or a non-IG MYC partner.
Lymphoblasts have finer blastic chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli and express TdT, CD34 or CD1a, lacking surface immunoglobulin.
Cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with CD5 expression and lacks CD10 with near 100% proliferation.
Blasts show fine chromatin and eosinophilic myelocytes may be present, with MPO, CD34, CD117 or lysozyme positivity.

61154.recognize_zh: 腸黏膜的固有層被密集、單一形態的中型細胞瀰漫取代，細胞核圓至卵圓、胞質淡嗜酸至透明、界限清楚，把腺體與絨毛狀突起撐開，表面上皮完整；需以 CD117/tryptase 證實為肥大細胞腸道浸潤。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and deeper mucosa
Monotonous medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei and moderate pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm
Distinct cell borders give a cohesive, somewhat epithelioid appearance
Overlying intestinal epithelium with goblet cells is intact; residual glands are widely separated
Scattered thin fibrous bands and capillaries; no lymphoepithelial lesions or necrosis evident
61154.describe_en: Section of intestinal mucosa shows an intact surface epithelium with goblet cells overlying a lamina propria that is diffusely expanded by a dense, monotonous infiltrate. The cells are medium-sized with round to oval nuclei, moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders, arranged in cohesive sheets that separate the residual glands. No lymphoepithelial lesions or necrosis are identified. In the context of known mast cell leukemia, the findings are consistent with gastrointestinal involvement by neoplastic mast cells, which should be confirmed with CD117, tryptase and CD25 immunostains.

ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma consists of small centrocyte-like B cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and CD20 positivity, lacking tryptase/CD117 expression.
Mantle cells are small with scant cytoplasm and irregular nuclei and express CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1.
Carcinoma shows greater nuclear pleomorphism, gland formation or infiltration of epithelium, and cytokeratin positivity.
Myeloid sarcoma has blastic chromatin with nucleoli and expresses MPO, lysozyme or CD34 rather than tryptase.

61026.recognize_zh: 左上方淋巴球的細胞質量多、淡藍透明，內含少數細小的嗜天青（azurophilic）紫紅色顆粒，核圓、染色質濃縮，是大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）；右下方淋巴球較小、細胞質少，可作為一般小淋巴球的對照。
features: Upper-left cell: medium-to-large lymphocyte with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and irregular cell outline
Several fine, discrete azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm
Round-to-slightly indented nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Lower-right cell: smaller lymphocyte with a thin rim of cytoplasm and few or no visible granules
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic; a single platelet at lower left
61026.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with two lymphocytes in the field. The upper lymphocyte is a large granular lymphocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm containing scattered fine azurophilic granules and a round nucleus with mature, clumped chromatin. The lower lymphocyte is smaller with a narrow cytoplasmic rim. A single granular lymphocyte is a normal finding; a sustained absolute LGL count above about 2 x 10^9/L, with cytopenias, would warrant flow cytometry and TCR clonality studies to evaluate for T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical cells; diagnosis requires persistent LGL expansion with a clonal CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ population (often STAT3 mutated) rather than an isolated LGL.
Reactive lymphocytes are larger with more basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and usually lack discrete azurophilic granules.
Monocytes have folded/lobulated nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with ground-glass rather than discrete granules.
Hairy cells have circumferential thin cytoplasmic projections and oval/bean-shaped nuclei with softer chromatin, without azurophilic granules.

60898.recognize_zh: 流式圖中 CD19+ 細胞共表現 CD5 且為 lambda 限制（紅色族群），組織切片為成片小淋巴細胞，免疫染色顯示 B 細胞弥漫陽性、lambda 陽性的漿細胞樣細胞散佈而 kappa 稀少，核染色（SOX11）陽性；FISH 在 B 細胞與漿細胞中皆可見融合訊號，表示漿細胞分化屬於同一被套細胞淋巴瘤克隆。
features: Flow cytometry (A-B): CD19-positive B cells with CD5 coexpression and lambda light-chain restriction (red population)
H&E (C): diffuse sheets of small, monotonous lymphoid cells (limited resolution)
IHC (D): diffuse B-cell marker positivity in the lymphoid infiltrate
IHC (E-F): numerous lambda-positive plasmacytic cells with only rare kappa-positive cells, indicating monotypic plasmacytic differentiation
IHC (G): strong nuclear staining in a large portion of the infiltrate, compatible with SOX11
Interphase FISH (H-I): comparable abnormal fusion signal patterns in both B cells and plasma cells, supporting clonal relatedness
60898.describe_en: Flow cytometry identifies a CD19-positive, CD5-positive B-cell population with lambda light-chain restriction. Tissue sections show diffuse sheets of small monotonous lymphoid cells that are positive for a B-cell marker and show strong nuclear staining compatible with SOX11 in much of the infiltrate. Lambda immunostain highlights numerous plasmacytic cells, whereas kappa-positive cells are rare, indicating monotypic plasmacytic differentiation. Interphase FISH performed separately on the B cells and plasma cells demonstrates similar abnormal fusion signals, supporting that both compartments belong to the same clone. Findings are consistent with CD5-positive, SOX11-positive mantle cell lymphoma with concomitant monotypic plasmacytic differentiation; image resolution limits detailed cytologic assessment.

ddx.vs: LPL is CD5 negative, SOX11 and cyclin D1 negative and usually carries MYD88 L265P, whereas this tumor is CD5 and SOX11 positive with a translocation shared by the plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL is typically CD5 negative and lacks SOX11 expression and CCND1 rearrangement.
CLL/SLL is CD5 positive but CD23 positive, cyclin D1 and SOX11 negative, with proliferation centers.

ddx.dx: Composite mantle cell lymphoma and plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: A separate plasma cell neoplasm would lack the FISH abnormality identical to the mantle cell component.

60898.stain: Flow cytometry; H&E; IHC (CD19, lambda, kappa, SOX11); FISH

60834.recognize_zh: A 圖組織被大片均質、鮭紅色的無結構物質取代，僅剩少數腺管或血管結構；B 圖偏光下呈蘋果綠／黃色雙折射，確認為類澱粉（amyloid）；C、D 圖顯示 IgM 陽性漿細胞樣細胞與大量 CD20 陽性 B 細胞，符合 Waldenström（淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤）相關的類澱粉瘤。
features: Extensive replacement of tissue by acellular, homogeneous, salmon-red amorphous deposits surrounding residual ductal/vascular structures (Congo red, panel A)
Apple-green to yellow birefringence of the deposits under polarized light (panel B)
IgM immunostain (panel C) showing diffuse background/cytoplasmic staining with numerous strongly positive plasmacytoid cells
CD20 immunostain (panel D) highlighting a dense infiltrate of B cells between adipocytes
Adipose-rich background with interstitial lymphoid infiltrate in panels C-D
60834.describe_en: Sections show a mass-forming deposit of acellular, homogeneous amorphous material that effaces the tissue and surrounds residual tubular/vascular structures, staining salmon-red with Congo red and exhibiting apple-green/yellow birefringence under polarized light, confirming amyloid. An associated lymphoid infiltrate within adipose tissue is composed of numerous CD20-positive B cells, with IgM-positive plasmacytoid cells and IgM-rich background staining. Findings are consistent with a localized amyloid deposit (amyloidoma) associated with an IgM-producing lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia); light-chain restriction, mass spectrometry typing of the amyloid and MYD88 L265P testing are recommended.

ddx.dx: AL amyloidosis due to plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasma cell myeloma-associated AL amyloid is accompanied by a CD138+/CD20-negative clonal plasma cell population with non-IgM heavy chain, whereas here a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate with IgM expression is present.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with amyloid
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma can also deposit amyloid with IgM plasmacytic differentiation but shows marginal zone/monocytoid B cells and lymphoepithelial lesions and usually lacks MYD88 L265P.
Collagen is fibrillar, stains less orange with Congo red and lacks apple-green birefringence under polarized light.

60834.stain: Congo red (bright-field and polarized); IHC: IgM, CD20
captions: A: Congo red with homogeneous salmon-red amyloid deposits; B: polarized Congo red with apple-green birefringence; C: IgM IHC with positive plasmacytoid cells; D: CD20 IHC with dense B-cell infiltrate

60770.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中在正常骨髓球系細胞之間，散在大型非典型淋巴細胞，核呈扭曲、分葉或花瓣狀（flower-like），細胞質深嗜鹼性並帶空泡，配合 HTLV-1 背景即指向成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤。
features: Scattered large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei convoluted, indented to multilobated with a clover-leaf/flower-like cell (lower center), coarse to moderately condensed chromatin
Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles in some atypical cells (upper left)
Admixed normal hematopoietic elements: myelocytes/metamyelocytes with pink granular cytoplasm and band/segmented neutrophils
Occasional smaller cells with dark condensed nuclei and a basophilic rim
60770.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large, highly atypical lymphoid cells admixed with maturing granulocytic precursors. The atypical cells have deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm and convoluted to multilobated nuclei, including flower-like forms, with moderately condensed chromatin. Normal myeloid maturation is still evident in the background. In a patient with HTLV-1 infection and a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform nuclear grooves rather than petal-like lobation and occur with erythroderma, are usually CD25-negative/weak, and lack HTLV-1.
Cells are small to medium with a single prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, TCL1-positive, and often CD4+/CD8+ with inv(14) rather than multilobated flower cells.
Monocytic cells have lacy chromatin, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and express CD14/CD64/lysozyme rather than T-cell markers.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and non-lobated nuclei, and show a polyclonal mixed T-cell population.

60578.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞增多，偏位核、核旁淡染區清楚；高倍可見漿細胞細胞質內吞入一個有核細胞（箭頭）或多個紅血球碎片（白箭頭），切片 H&E 也可見漿細胞內含紅血球（黑箭頭），屬罕見的腫瘤漿細胞吞噬現象。
features: Increased plasma cells, including binucleate and immature forms with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Plasma cell engulfing an intact nucleated cell surrounded by a clear phagocytic vacuole (panel B arrow)
Plasma cell containing multiple phagocytosed red cells/fragments within vacuoles (panel C arrow)
Biopsy: sheets of plasma cells with intracytoplasmic erythrocytes (arrows)
No macrophage features (no abundant foamy cytoplasm) in the phagocytic cells, which retain plasma cell morphology
60578.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows increased plasma cells, including immature and binucleated forms with prominent perinuclear hofs. Several neoplastic plasma cells contain phagocytosed elements, including an intact nucleated cell within a clear vacuole and multiple erythrocytes, while retaining eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. The core biopsy shows sheets of plasma cells, some with intracytoplasmic red cells. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with hemophagocytosis by neoplastic plasma cells.

ddx.vs: In HLH the phagocytes are benign CD68/CD163-positive macrophages with abundant cytoplasm, not CD138-positive plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies or crystalline inclusions
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are homogeneous immunoglobulin globules without the internal structure of engulfed red cells or nuclei.
Emperipolesis occurs in large multilobated megakaryocytes and the enclosed cells are viable, not within plasma cells.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and are keratin-positive, lacking hofs and CD138/light-chain restriction.

60642.recognize_zh: 數位影像分析（如 CellaVision）的細胞圖庫中，上排為核圓、染色質塊狀的典型小型 CLL 淋巴球，下排則為較大、核形不規則或有切跡、細胞質較多的非典型淋巴球，兩群並存提示非典型 CLL。
features: Digital morphology analyzer gallery of individually cropped peripheral blood lymphocytes
Upper rows: small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, condensed clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (typical CLL cells)
Lower rows: larger lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated, notched or cleaved nuclei
Atypical cells have coarser but less condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm
No obvious prominent nucleoli visible at this resolution
60642.describe_en: Digital image gallery of the peripheral blood shows two populations of lymphoid cells. One consists of small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, while the other comprises larger cells with irregular, cleaved or angulated nuclei and more abundant cytoplasm. The cropped images limit assessment of smudge cells and overall cell counts. Findings are suggestive of atypical chronic lymphocytic leukemia with cleaved/atypical lymphocytes; flow cytometry (CD5, CD23, CD200, FMC7, light-chain intensity) and cyclin D1/SOX11 or t(11;14) testing are needed to exclude mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MCL cells also show notched nuclei but are CD23 negative/CD200 dim, cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive with t(11;14).
FL buttock cells have deep narrow clefts with CD10+ and BCL2 t(14;18), whereas CLL is CD5+/CD23+ and CD10 negative.
SMZL cells have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are typically CD5 and CD23 negative.
Sézary cells have cerebriform convoluted nuclei and a CD4+ T-cell phenotype with loss of CD7/CD26.

60514.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球比小淋巴球大，外形被周圍紅血球擠壓成水滴狀，細胞質中等量且邊緣呈較深的藍色（peripheral basophilia），核染色質較開放並隱約可見核仁，符合反應性淋巴球（reactive lymphocyte）。
features: Enlarged lymphocyte, about twice the diameter of adjacent red cells in its long axis
Oval nucleus with moderately condensed but more open chromatin than a resting lymphocyte; one or two small nucleolus-like dark spots
Moderate cytoplasm with deeper blue basophilia accentuated at the periphery
Cell outline molded by and indented around neighboring red cells
No cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles; background red cells with occasional crenated form
60514.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged lymphocyte with an oval nucleus, moderately condensed to partly open chromatin and small nucleolus-like chromocenters. The cytoplasm is moderate in amount with basophilia accentuated at the cell margin, and the cell contour is molded by adjacent red cells. No cytoplasmic granules are seen. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphocyte, as seen in viral infections such as infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic lymphocytes form a monotonous population with nuclear irregularities such as clefts or convolutions, whereas reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous and show peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia hugging red cells.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles rather than a sharply basophilic rim.
Blasts have very fine uniform chromatin, distinct nucleoli, a high N:C ratio and do not show peripheral basophilia molding around red cells.
Plasmacytoid lymphocytes have an eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and uniformly deep blue cytoplasm, sometimes with a hof.

60450.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中細胞密集、幾乎沒有脂肪，大多數細胞是核分葉、深染且常呈多個分離小圓塊的成熟嗜中性球，前驅細胞相對少（右移）；在周邊血嗜中性球減少的病人出現這種骨髓內成熟嗜中性球堆積，提示骨髓滯留症（myelokathexis）／WHIM 症候群。
features: Densely hypercellular marrow with no intervening fat in this field
Marked granulocytic predominance (increased M:E ratio) with right shift: most cells are mature segmented neutrophils
Many neutrophil nuclei appear as multiple small, dark, separated round fragments (hypersegmented/pyknotic-appearing lobes)
Fewer myelocytes/metamyelocytes and scattered erythroid precursors; occasional megakaryocyte and eosinophil
No blast clusters or abnormal infiltrate
60450.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a hypercellular marrow composed predominantly of granulocytic cells, with an increased M:E ratio. Maturation is right-shifted, with abundant mature neutrophils whose nuclei frequently appear hyperlobated and fragmented into small, dense, separated lobes. Erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes are relatively reduced but present, and blasts are not increased. In a neutropenic patient, accumulation of mature, apoptotic-appearing neutrophils within the marrow is consistent with myelokathexis, supporting WHIM syndrome in the given clinical setting.

ddx.vs: CML shows a full left-shifted myeloid spectrum with a myelocyte bulge, basophilia, small hypolobated megakaryocytes and peripheral leukocytosis, whereas myelokathexis shows right-shifted retained neutrophils with peripheral neutropenia.
Reactive hyperplasia is typically left-shifted with peripheral neutrophilia, not dominated by hypersegmented fragmented mature neutrophils in a neutropenic patient.

Autoimmune neutropenia may show normal or increased marrow granulopoiesis with late-stage depletion, but lacks the characteristic pyknotic, filament-joined nuclear lobes; aspirate cytology and CXCR4 testing separate them.

60386.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 下，大量深染的小淋巴球背景中，散布許多具淡染細胞質、大核與明顯核仁的大型非典型細胞，部分帶有周圍空暈（lacunar 樣），符合 SLL 背景下的 Hodgkin 型大細胞。
features: Background of numerous small, round, hyperchromatic mature-appearing lymphocytes
Scattered large atypical cells with abundant pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Large vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli in the large cells
Some large cells show retraction artifact producing lacunar-like halos
Polymorphous areas with histiocytes/epithelioid cells admixed with the large cells
Diffuse effacement of architecture; small vessels with red cells
60386.describe_en: Sections of lymph node show diffuse effacement by a background of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes. Within this background there are numerous scattered large atypical cells with abundant pale cytoplasm, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, some with lacunar-like retraction halos, accompanied by histiocytes. Immunophenotyping (CD30, CD15, PAX5, CD45, CD20) is needed to confirm Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell identity. Findings are consistent with small lymphocytic lymphoma with Hodgkin-type Richter transformation.

ddx.vs: Paraimmunoblasts are medium-sized with a single central nucleolus and are CD20+/CD30-, unlike HRS cells which are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD45 negativity.
DLBCL forms confluent sheets of large CD20+ B cells rather than scattered large cells within a small lymphocyte background.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: Background atypical T cells with aberrant T-cell phenotype or clonal TCR rearrangement distinguish it; here the background is CD20+ SLL.

60194.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中紅色的 CD45 弱表現、低側散射（SSC）母細胞群為 CD34+、CD117+、CD13+、HLA-DR+，CD19 與 CD7 陰性、CD14 陰性，並在 CD56 呈部分陽性，代表增多的骨髓性母細胞帶異常抗原表現。
features: CD45 vs SSC plot: gated blast population (red) with dim CD45 and low side scatter, separate from lymphocytes and granulocytes (gray)
Blasts are CD34 positive and CD19 negative
Partial CD56 expression with CD7 negative
CD13 and HLA-DR positive; CD33 dim to partial
CD117 positive and CD14 negative, supporting an immature myeloid rather than monocytic phenotype
60194.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows a distinct population of events in the CD45-dim, low side scatter blast region (highlighted in red). The gated blasts express CD34, CD117, CD13 and HLA-DR, with dim to partial CD33, and are negative for CD19, CD7 and CD14. Partial aberrant expression of CD56 is present. These findings indicate an increased myeloblast population with an aberrant immunophenotype; in conjunction with the reported blast count (11%), they support myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts-2.

ddx.vs: The same immunophenotype can be seen in AML, which is separated by a blast percentage of ≥20% on morphologic counts rather than by flow.
Regenerating CD34+ blasts show a normal maturation pattern with hematogones and lack aberrant CD56 or CD7 expression.
B-ALL blasts are CD19 positive with CD10/CD22/CD79a, whereas these blasts are CD19 negative and express CD13/CD117.

60130.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一大團彼此黏附的腫瘤細胞，細胞質深藍、含細小空泡，核圓且相互擠壓，與周圍分散的造血細胞明顯不同；此團細胞呈上皮樣黏聚，提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive syncytial-appearing cluster of small-to-medium round tumor cells
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with fine punctate vacuoles
Round nuclei with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and nuclear molding
Scattered dispersed single cells with similar features and occasional histiocytes nearby
Background red cells with drying artifact; neuropil not prominent in this field
60130.describe_en: Wright-Giemsa-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of small to medium-sized tumor cells with round, molded nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles. Similar cells are scattered singly nearby, along with occasional histiocytes, and red cells show drying artifact. Neuropil is not conspicuous in this field. Cohesive clusters of non-hematopoietic small round cells are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma in this clinical context.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells also have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are discohesive, CD45 and CD20 positive with MYC rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma clusters can be vacuolated and cohesive, requiring desmin/myogenin and FOXO1 rearrangement to separate.
Ewing sarcoma cells show PAS-positive glycogen vacuoles and CD99/NKX2.2 staining with EWSR1 fusion.
Megakaryoblasts may cluster and have blebbed basophilic cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive, unlike PHOX2B-positive neuroblastoma.

60066.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小形狀差異極大，淚滴細胞、橢圓與碎片細胞到處可見，並有部分淡染紅血球形成雙相族群；下方一顆紅血球含粗大嗜鹼性點彩，上方與右側可見偏藍的多染性紅血球；這些是鐵粒母細胞性貧血等無效造血的周邊血液線索。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells, elliptocytes, and fragmented red cells
Dimorphic red cell population with a subset of hypochromic cells
Red cell with coarse basophilic stippling in the lower field
Occasional polychromatophilic red cells (bluish-gray, larger)
Single small lymphocyte in center; platelets present but not increased; no nucleated red cells in this field
60066.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells, elliptocytes, and fragmented red cells, and a dimorphic population that includes a subset of hypochromic cells. A red cell in the lower field contains coarse basophilic stippling, and occasional polychromatophilic red cells are present. A single small lymphocyte is seen, and nucleated red cells are not present in this particular field. Findings are consistent with ineffective erythropoiesis and are suggestive of sideroblastic anemia in this clinical context; correlation with red cell indices and a marrow iron stain is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows microcytosis with target cells and stippling, but usually a uniformly microcytic population and increased HbF/HbA2 rather than a dimorphic picture with ring sideroblasts.
Coarse basophilic stippling is prominent but poikilocytosis is milder, and blood lead and zinc protoporphyrin are elevated.
Teardrop cells occur with a leukoerythroblastic picture (nucleated red cells, immature granulocytes) and giant platelets, with marrow fibrosis.
Can be dimorphic with stippling, but is usually macrocytic with neutrophil hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger forms in older adults.

27938.recognize_zh: 一團大型原始細胞核大、染色質細緻均勻，胞質淡藍、含細小嗜天青顆粒並有少量空泡，旁邊仍可見分化中的顆粒球（帶狀核嗜中性球），屬於有部分成熟的 AML 樣貌；CEBPA 突變無法單憑形態判定，需分子檢測。
features: Cluster of large blasts with high-to-moderate N:C ratio and round to polygonal nuclei
Finely dispersed, delicate chromatin with a pinkish-violet hue; nucleoli inconspicuous and small nuclear vacuoles in one cell
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granulation and occasional vacuoles; no Auer rods seen
Background residual maturing granulocytes (band neutrophil, promyelocyte/myelocyte) and a small lymphocyte
27938.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate amounts of pale basophilic cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules and scattered vacuoles. Auer rods are not identified in this field. Maturing granulocytic elements, including a band neutrophil and promyelocyte/myelocyte forms, and a small lymphocyte are present in the background. The morphology is that of acute myeloid leukemia with some granulocytic maturation; the diagnosis of AML with CEBPA mutation (typically biallelic or in-frame bZIP) requires molecular confirmation, as there are no specific morphologic features.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) blasts have salmon-colored perinuclear hofs, long single Auer rods and dysplastic neutrophils, but ultimately genetic testing separates it.
NPM1-mutated AML often shows cup-like nuclear invaginations and CD34 negativity, confirmed by NPM1 testing or cytoplasmic NPM1 IHC.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei, dense azurophilic granules or faggot cells and PML::RARA, not the sparse fine granules seen here.
Lymphoblasts lack azurophilic granules and are MPO-negative with TdT and B/T lymphoid antigen expression.

21858.recognize_zh: MRI 顯示顱底及腰椎馬尾神經根周圍的軟腦膜顯影病灶（箭頭）；腦脊髓液抹片（B）見大量核偏位、有核旁淡染區（hof）、部分雙核的漿細胞；流式（C）呈 CD38/CD138 雙陽性族群，證實為漿細胞白血病的軟腦膜轉移。
features: MRI: enhancing focal lesion at the skull base (axial) and nodular leptomeningeal enhancement along the lumbar cauda equina (sagittal)
CSF cytospin: numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin and perinuclear hof
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some cells binucleate or with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Monomorphic population with minimal admixed lymphocytes or monocytes
Flow cytometry: discrete CD38-bright/CD138-positive population gated as plasma cells
21858.describe_en: Contrast-enhanced MRI shows an enhancing skull-base lesion and nodular leptomeningeal enhancement along the cauda equina. The CSF cytospin is highly cellular and composed of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, perinuclear clearing and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, including binucleate forms. Flow cytometry of the CSF demonstrates a distinct CD38-bright, CD138-positive plasma cell population. Findings are consistent with leptomeningeal involvement by plasma cell leukemia (CNS myelomatosis); light chain restriction should be documented.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are few, mixed with lymphocytes and polytypic for kappa and lambda.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by lymphoma with plasmacytoid differentiation
ddx.vs: Lymphoplasmacytic or plasmablastic lymphoma cells show a B-cell or plasmablastic phenotype with CD20 or high Ki-67 and a mixed lymphoid component.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin-positive and CD138/CD38-negative on flow.

21730.recognize_zh: 三個畫面都是體積很大的巨噬細胞，細胞質內吞入十餘顆完整的有核細胞（多為小淋巴球）及紅血球，C 圖並含黑色色素顆粒；在發燒與全血球低下的 CLL 病人，符合噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Very large macrophages with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm
Cytoplasm contains numerous engulfed intact nucleated cells, predominantly small round lymphocyte-like nuclei
Phagocytosed erythrocytes and dark pigment/debris in panel C
Panel A: the same phenomenon highlighted with a different (unspecified) stain showing red-brown ingested nuclei
Adjacent free small lymphocytes and red cells in the background
21730.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show large macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous engulfed intact nucleated cells, predominantly small lymphocytes, as well as erythrocytes and pigmented debris. Panel A demonstrates a similar histiocyte with a different staining method. The ingested cells retain nuclear integrity rather than appearing as apoptotic fragments. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in a febrile, pancytopenic patient with CLL, correlation with HLH-2004 criteria (ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25, organomegaly) and evaluation for infection are recommended.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris of varying size rather than intact whole cells.
In emperipolesis intact cells pass through megakaryocytes or Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes (S100-positive) without being degraded.
Overlapped cells lie in different focal planes and are not enclosed by a continuous macrophage cytoplasmic membrane.
Cannibalism is performed by atypical carcinoma or lymphoma cells rather than CD68/CD163-positive benign histiocytes.

15202.recognize_zh: A 圖前臂與手背多顆潰瘍、結痂的大型腫瘤；B 圖軀幹多發紫紅色結節，部分中央潰瘍；C 圖存活曲線顯示大細胞轉化組（虛線）存活較差，整體指向蕈狀肉芽腫大細胞轉化（large cell transformation）。
features: Panel A: multiple large ulcerated, crusted, fungating tumors on the forearm and dorsum of hand
Panel B: numerous violaceous dome-shaped nodules on the trunk, some with central ulceration
Panel C: Kaplan-Meier overall survival curve comparing no transformation (solid) versus large-cell transformation (dashed)
Survival curve for transformation plateaus near 30-40% versus ~40% longer-term for non-transformed cases, with earlier drop in the transformed group
Clinical photographs and a graph; no histology shown
15202.describe_en: Composite figure. Panels A and B are clinical photographs showing multiple ulcerated and fungating tumors on the forearm and hand and numerous violaceous nodules, several centrally ulcerated, on the anterior trunk. Panel C is a Kaplan-Meier plot of overall survival in years, in which patients with large-cell transformation (dashed line) show an earlier and steeper decline in survival than those without transformation (solid line). The clinical picture of rapidly enlarging, ulcerating tumors is consistent with transformed mycosis fungoides; the diagnosis itself requires biopsy demonstrating large cells comprising more than 25% of the infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: C-ALCL lacks a prior history of patch/plaque MF and usually shows localized nodules; transformed MF may also be CD30+, so clinical history is the key discriminator.
LyP produces recurrent, self-healing papulonodules that regress within weeks, unlike the persistent enlarging tumors seen here.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by systemic peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Systemic PTCL shows nodal/visceral disease at presentation on staging, whereas transformed MF evolves from long-standing skin-limited disease.

captions: A: Ulcerated tumors on forearm and hand; B: ulcerated violaceous nodules on trunk; C: overall survival by large-cell transformation status

4194.recognize_zh: 一個巨噬細胞的胞質內塞滿數十個小而均勻的卵圓形紫色小體，大小遠小於紅血球，部分可見旁側較小的點狀構造（kinetoplast），這是利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（amastigote，LD body）的典型表現。
features: Macrophage with abundant pale cytoplasm packed with numerous small (2–4 um) oval intracellular organisms
Organisms of uniform size with a dark-staining nucleus; a smaller rod-like kinetoplast is suggested in some but is not crisply resolved
Organisms cluster over the macrophage nucleus and are also dispersed throughout its cytoplasm
Adjacent intact cell with dense nucleus; background of red cells and fine granular debris
No capsule or halo around the organisms
4194.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage whose cytoplasm is distended by numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular organisms, each with a dark nucleus and a suggested smaller kinetoplast. No surrounding capsule or clear halo is seen. The background contains red cells and granular debris. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies), supporting visceral leishmaniasis; confirmation by PCR, culture or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are surrounded by a clear pseudocapsule halo and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast, and usually appear as pseudocysts rather than packed macrophages.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated sausage-shaped with a central transverse septum and no kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Platelets or phagocytosed debris overlying a macrophage
ddx.vs: Platelets and debris are irregular and variable in size, without the uniform oval shape and nucleus-plus-kinetoplast pattern of amastigotes.

13858.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一個圓形細胞的核被密集深紫色（異染性）顆粒遮蓋，顆粒大小一致並散落到細胞周圍背景，形似嗜鹼性球但核呈圓形不分葉，為循環中的肥大細胞，符合肥大細胞白血病。
features: Single intermediate-sized round cell among red cells
Round, non-lobulated nucleus largely obscured by granules
Dense, uniform dark purple metachromatic cytoplasmic granules
Numerous granules dispersed around the cell, suggesting degranulation or smear disruption
Background red cells with scattered small granular debris; no other leukocytes in field
13858.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating cell with a round, non-lobulated nucleus obscured by dense, uniform, dark purple metachromatic granules, with many granules dispersed into the surrounding background. The appearance is that of a mast cell rather than a basophil. In the appropriate context, and if circulating mast cells constitute at least 10% of leukocytes or marrow aspirate mast cells are at least 20%, findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia; confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry, serum tryptase and KIT D816V testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophils have a lobulated or segmented nucleus and water-soluble granules, and are CD123 and CD203c positive but CD117 negative.
Basophilic blasts are immature with fine chromatin and nucleoli and are tryptase negative or weak, lacking KIT D816V.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with coarse azurophilic granules (e.g. APL)
ddx.vs: Promyelocytes show reddish-purple granules, Auer rods and strong MPO positivity rather than metachromatic toluidine-blue-positive granules.

7202.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有數顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色並有細小空泡，核染色質細緻且核扭曲、摺疊或凹陷（promonocyte 樣），這些不成熟單核球樣細胞增加提示急性單核球性白血病。
features: Increased large mononuclear cells, about 2 to 2.5 times the diameter of a red cell
Moderate to low N:C ratio with folded, indented or convoluted nuclei
Fine, delicate chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and scattered fine azurophilic granules
Background shows a small lymphocyte, a band neutrophil, a platelet clump and normocytic red cells without schistocytes
7202.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large mononuclear cells with abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing sparse fine granules. Their nuclei are folded, indented or convoluted with fine, delicate chromatin, features of promonocytes and immature monocytes. A small lymphocyte and a band neutrophil are present; red cells are unremarkable and Auer rods are not seen. Findings are suggestive of acute monocytic leukemia; correlation with blast/promonocyte count, nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD36) is required.

ddx.vs: CMML contains mostly mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and lobulated nuclei, and promonocytes plus blasts are less than 20%.
Reactive monocytes have more condensed chromatin, lack a population of promonocytes/monoblasts, and resolve with the underlying infection or inflammation.
AMML additionally has at least 20% neutrophil-lineage cells in the marrow with myeloblasts that may contain Auer rods, rather than an exclusively monocytic population.
Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei, strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA, whereas monocytic cells are MPO weak and NSE positive.

5858.recognize_zh: CD163 免疫染色下，組織內大片細胞呈強棕色膜及細胞質陽性，血管腔內還聚集體積明顯較大、有空泡或多核的異型陽性細胞，顯示這些異型細胞為組織球（巨噬細胞）來源。
features: Diffuse sheets of cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD163 positivity infiltrating the tissue
Clusters of large atypical CD163-positive cells within dilated vascular/sinusoidal spaces
Intravascular cells show abundant cytoplasm, some vacuolated, with occasional multinucleated or bizarre forms
Negative fibrous stroma and vessel walls at the top of the field
Hematoxylin counterstain; nuclear detail limited by strong chromogen
5858.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD163 shows diffuse sheets of strongly positive cells infiltrating the tissue, together with clusters of large atypical, occasionally vacuolated or multinucleated CD163-positive cells lying within dilated vascular or sinusoidal spaces. The fibrous stroma is negative. Nuclear atypia is difficult to assess under the dense chromogen and should be evaluated on the H&E. Findings support histiocytic (macrophage) lineage of the atypical cells and, in a patient with a prior hematologic neoplasm, are consistent with secondary histiocytic sarcoma/malignant histiocytosis, although reactive histiocytes must be excluded by morphology and clonal studies.

ddx.vs: Reactive histiocytes are CD163 positive but cytologically bland, without marked nuclear atypia, mitoses or clonal genetic alterations shared with the prior neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma or other large cell lymphoma with intrasinusoidal spread
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD163 negative and express CD30, ALK or lymphoid lineage markers.
Langerhans cells have grooved nuclei and are CD1a and langerin (CD207) positive, whereas CD163 is typically negative.
It can express CD163 but also shows CD34, CD117, MPO or lysozyme with blastic cytology and usually coexistent marrow AML.

1378.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的細胞團塊（particle）中可見數顆大型、核深染的巨核細胞，巨核細胞數量不減少，周圍有紅血球系與骨髓系前驅細胞及嗜伊紅球；在血小板低下病人，巨核細胞正常或增加提示周邊破壞型血小板低下，如 HIV 相關血小板低下。
features: Cellular marrow particle containing several megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes vary in size, several with dense, hyperchromatic, compact nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Numerous erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and myeloid precursors
Occasional eosinophils with orange granules
No clusters of blasts or overt dysplasia identifiable at this magnification
1378.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing several megakaryocytes of varying size, some with dense hyperchromatic nuclei, together with trilineage hematopoietic precursors and occasional eosinophils. Megakaryocytes are not decreased. Detailed assessment of dysplasia is limited by cell overlap within the particle. In a patient with HIV infection and isolated thrombocytopenia, adequate to increased megakaryocytes support a peripheral destructive mechanism (immune thrombocytopenia), although HIV-associated marrow dysplasia and ineffective megakaryopoiesis may coexist.

ddx.vs: Marrow appearance is indistinguishable; separation relies on HIV serology and clinical context.
Shows small hypolobated micromegakaryocytes or separated nuclear lobes with dysplasia in other lineages and often clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Megakaryocytes are decreased or absent rather than preserved.

2338.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中，箭頭處一顆紅血球內有細小藍色環狀體與紅色染色質點（ring form），代表瘧原蟲感染；單一環狀體無法確定種別，需搭配受感染紅血球變大、Schüffner 點或變形蟲樣滋養體才能判定間日瘧。
features: Single intraerythrocytic ring form (arrow) with thin blue cytoplasmic ring and small chromatin dot
Infected red cell not clearly enlarged at this magnification
No Schüffner stippling, amoeboid trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes seen in this field
Two neutrophils in the upper right corner
Background red cells normocytic with scattered normal platelets
2338.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows a single red cell containing a small ring-form parasite (arrow) with a delicate blue cytoplasmic ring and chromatin dot. The infected cell is not distinctly enlarged and no stippling, trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes are visible in this field; red cells and neutrophils are otherwise unremarkable. Findings indicate Plasmodium infection; a single ring form does not permit speciation, so the diagnosis of P. vivax requires additional forms on thin film review, rapid antigen testing or PCR, and parasitemia should be quantified.

ddx.vs: Rings are typically numerous, delicate, often double-chromatin or multiply infected, with banana-shaped gametocytes and no red cell enlargement.
Small pleomorphic rings, extracellular forms and tetrads, without pigment, schizonts or gametocytes.
Lies in a different plane with granular texture and no ring cytoplasm or chromatin dot.

1186.recognize_zh: 一顆巨大、核多葉且重疊的成熟巨核細胞，細胞質豐富呈顆粒狀，周邊可見成群血小板正在脫落（platelet budding），左上方另有一顆嗜中性球被包入細胞質（emperipolesis）。
features: Very large cell (several times the diameter of surrounding red cells)
Single large, multilobated, overlapping nucleus with dense, coarse chromatin and no nucleoli
Abundant lilac-blue, finely granular mature cytoplasm
Clusters of platelets budding from the cytoplasmic periphery
Neutrophil with pink cytoplasm engulfed within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Background of normocytic red cells
1186.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a single large mature megakaryocyte surrounded by red cells. The cell has a large multilobated nucleus with coarse, condensed chromatin and abundant granular cytoplasm, with clusters of platelets separating from the peripheral cytoplasm. A neutrophil is present within the cytoplasm, representing emperipolesis. Findings are consistent with a normal mature platelet-producing megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate round nuclei with nucleoli rather than one multilobated nucleus, and do not shed platelets.
Dysplastic forms show small hypolobated or widely separated nuclear lobes, whereas this cell has a normally lobulated compact nucleus.
Immature forms have deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin, lacking the granular mature cytoplasm and platelet budding seen here.

1122.recognize_zh: 三顆中型淋巴球，胞質嗜鹼性且無顆粒，核圓到略不規則，可見小核仁（箭頭），核質比中等，呈 T-PLL 的前淋巴球型態。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than normal small lymphocytes
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Small but visible nucleolus (arrow)
Moderate rim of basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with slightly irregular outline
Normochromic red cells in background
1122.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and a small visible nucleolus (arrow). The cytoplasm is moderate, basophilic and agranular with a slightly irregular border. No hairy projections or cerebriform nuclei are seen. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (mature T-cell, TCL1 overexpression).

ddx.vs: B-prolymphocytes have a larger, more prominent central nucleolus and paler cytoplasm, with B-cell phenotype.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei with scant cytoplasm and are typically CD7-negative and CD26-negative.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous in size with abundant cytoplasm indenting around red cells and lack a clonal T-cell population.

1058.recognize_zh: 厚區抹片中有多顆胞質嗜鹼性、染色質細緻的母細胞（blast），旁邊夾雜含橘紅色粗顆粒的嗜酸性骨髓球、嗜鹼性顆粒細胞與分葉嗜中性球；CML 背景中母細胞增加，符合加速期／復發。
features: Several blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Eosinophilic myelocyte with coarse orange-red granules surrounding an immature nucleus
Granulated immature cells and a basophil with dark granules at the right
Band/segmented neutrophil and a small dark-staining cell (lymphocyte or late erythroblast)
Thick smear area with crowded, dried red cells; specimen type (blood vs marrow) not certain from this field
1058.describe_en: Smear from a thick area shows increased blasts, which are medium to large cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, and basophilic cytoplasm. They are admixed with granulocytic precursors, including an eosinophilic myelocyte with coarse orange granules, a basophil, and a neutrophil. Red cells are crowded with drying artifact, and it cannot be determined with certainty whether this is blood or marrow. In the context of known CML, findings are consistent with disease progression with increased blasts (accelerated/blast phase); blast enumeration and ABL1 kinase domain mutation analysis (e.g., T315I) are indicated.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase shows a myelocyte and neutrophil peak with blasts <10% (typically <2% in blood), not clusters of blasts.
De novo AML lacks the preceding CML history, basophilia, and full spectrum of maturing granulocytes, and often shows lower BCR::ABL1 burden in myeloid subsets.
CMML shows absolute monocytosis with dysplasia and no BCR::ABL1 fusion, and basophilia and eosinophilic myelocytes are not prominent.

4066.recognize_zh: 中央四個小到中型淋巴球，細胞質少、深藍色，邊緣有明顯的細胞質突起（blebs），核形略不規則、染色質中度凝集，兩側有破碎的污斑細胞，符合 T 前淋巴球性白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Small-to-medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs/protrusions
Round to irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous in these cells
Two smudge cells flanking the field
Background RBCs normocytic with occasional crenated forms
4066.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, and scant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with conspicuous cytoplasmic blebs. Nucleoli are not prominent in these particular cells (small-cell variant morphology). Two smudge cells are present. In the setting of marked lymphocytosis, findings are suggestive of T-prolymphocytic leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry and TCL1A/MTCP1 rearrangement or TCL1 immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have soccer-ball clumped chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm without blebs, and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells.
Sézary cells show cerebriform, deeply grooved nuclei rather than round nuclei with basophilic blebbed cytoplasm.
ATLL cells have polylobated 'flower' nuclei and are CD25+/HTLV-1 associated, TCL1-negative.

ddx.dx: B-prolymphocytic leukemia / splenic marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: B-PLL cells have a single prominent central nucleolus, and SMZL cells show polar villi; both are B-lineage by flow.

3938.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片幾乎被大型單核母細胞（monoblasts）佔滿：細胞核圓形、染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色且無 Auer 小體，符合急性單核母細胞白血病；本圖為骨髓而非皮膚切片。
features: Sheets of large blasts with abundant moderately basophilic grey-blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly oval nuclei with fine lacy chromatin
One or more distinct nucleoli in many cells
Low to moderate N:C ratio with occasional faint cytoplasmic granules
No Auer rods identified
Rare residual neutrophils and erythroid precursors
3938.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and nearly replaced by large blasts with abundant grey-blue, moderately basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei, delicate lacy chromatin and prominent nucleoli. Auer rods are not seen, and residual granulocytic and erythroid elements are markedly reduced. Although titled leukemia cutis, this image depicts the marrow rather than the skin lesion. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14, CD64, CD11b, CD4) are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have a higher N:C ratio, less abundant cytoplasm, may contain Auer rods and are MPO positive, whereas monoblasts are NSE positive with weak or absent MPO.
Plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138/CD38 bright, lacking monocytic markers.
Lymphoma cells often show deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and express B- or T-cell markers rather than CD14/CD64 and lysozyme.

3618.recognize_zh: 低倍即可見大量紅血球內含纖細的環狀體（ring form），部分有雙染色質點、部分紅血球同時被多隻寄生蟲感染，受感染紅血球大小正常，且不見滋養體或裂殖體，符合惡性瘧（Plasmodium falciparum）。
features: High parasitemia with numerous red cells containing small delicate ring forms
Rings with double chromatin dots and appliqué (accolé) forms at the red cell margin
Multiply infected red cells present
Infected red cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner stippling
Absence of mature trophozoites and schizonts in the peripheral blood
3618.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-intermediate power shows a high parasite burden, with numerous red cells containing small, delicate ring-form trophozoites. Double chromatin dots, appliqué forms at the red cell periphery, and red cells infected by more than one parasite are readily identified. Infected red cells are normal in size without stippling, and no mature trophozoites, schizonts, or banana-shaped gametocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria; percent parasitemia should be quantified.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings are pleomorphic, may form tetrad (Maltese cross) arrangements, lack hemozoin pigment, and are not accompanied by gametocytes.
Infected red cells are enlarged with Schüffner stippling, and all stages including ameboid trophozoites and schizonts are seen.
Early rings can mimic falciparum but band-form trophozoites and schizonts appear in blood; PCR is needed for species confirmation.
Superimposed platelets lack a cytoplasmic ring with a discrete chromatin dot and lie in a different focal plane.

3554.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球普遍變形：大量橢圓形與細長的橢圓球（elliptocytes），夾雜許多形狀怪異的碎片、出芽狀紅血球與小球形紅血球（microspherocytes），大小差異極大，是遺傳性熱變性異形紅血球症的特徵。
features: Marked poikilocytosis with numerous elliptocytes and elongated ovalocytes
Many red cell fragments, budding forms and bizarre irregular shapes
Small dense microspherocytes scattered throughout
Striking anisocytosis with many microcytic cells, compatible with a very low MCV
Occasional normal-appearing segmented neutrophil and normal platelets
3554.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows severe anisopoikilocytosis with numerous elliptocytes, bizarre budding and fragmented red cells, and scattered microspherocytes, with many markedly microcytic cells. The single neutrophil present is morphologically normal and platelets are unremarkable. In the appropriate clinical setting (severe hemolytic anemia, often presenting in infancy and in individuals of African ancestry), findings are consistent with hereditary pyropoikilocytosis. Confirmation includes a family study (parents often with hereditary elliptocytosis), eosin-5-maleimide flow cytometry, osmotic gradient ektacytometry and spectrin genetic analysis.

ddx.vs: Shows predominantly uniform elliptocytes with little fragmentation or microspherocytosis and usually mild or no anemia.
Features true helmet cells and triangular schistocytes with thrombocytopenia, without a background of numerous elliptocytes.
Produces similar microspherocytes and budding fragments, but is acquired, transient and occurs with a history of burns rather than chronic hereditary hemolysis.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency anemia with pencil cells
ddx.vs: Shows hypochromic microcytic cells with widened central pallor and elongated pencil cells but lacks fragmentation and microspherocytes.

3490.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的細胞質內有多條交錯成束的 Auer rods（faggot cell），周圍是細胞質充滿顆粒、核呈折疊或雙葉狀的異常前骨髓細胞，典型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）表現。
features: Abnormal promyelocyte (arrow) with bundles of multiple crisscrossing Auer rods (faggot cell)
Surrounding large cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules obscuring nuclear borders
Nuclei folded, reniform, or bilobed with fine chromatin
Monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes without normal maturation in field
3490.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules and folded to bilobed nuclei with fine chromatin. One cell (arrow) contains bundles of numerous crisscrossing Auer rods, a so-called faggot cell. Normal maturing granulocytic elements are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA; urgent coagulation studies and molecular confirmation are recommended.

ddx.vs: AML with t(8;21) typically shows single long slender Auer rods and salmon-colored granules with maturation, not bundles of Auer rods in hypergranular promyelocytes.

ddx.dx: Reactive left shift with increased promyelocytes
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have round nuclei with a Golgi hof and orderly maturation, and never contain Auer rods.
The PLZF variant shows more regular nuclei and pseudo-Pelger cells with fewer faggot cells and is ATRA-resistant, requiring molecular testing to separate.

3426.recognize_zh: 兩顆分節中性球（紅色箭頭）細胞質邊緣各有淡藍灰色的小斑塊，即杜勒小體（Döhle bodies）；細胞質顆粒並未變粗、也沒有空泡，所以沒有毒性變化。
features: Two segmented neutrophils with small pale blue-gray cytoplasmic patches at the periphery (arrows)
Neutrophil cytoplasm otherwise pale with normal fine granulation; no toxic granulation or vacuolization
Nuclear segmentation normal (2–4 lobes)
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and overlapping in a thick area of the smear
Scattered platelets
3426.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a relatively thick area, shows two segmented neutrophils each containing a small, pale blue-gray peripheral cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a Döhle body. The neutrophils lack toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuolization. Red cells are overlapping; platelets are present. Findings are consistent with Döhle bodies without accompanying toxic changes, which may be seen in pregnancy, burns, G-CSF therapy or early infection; if inclusions are large and present in all neutrophils with thrombocytopenia and giant platelets, MYH9-related disorder should be considered.

ddx.vs: May-Hegglin inclusions are larger, more spindle-shaped, present in nearly all granulocytes and accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Sepsis-related Döhle bodies are usually accompanied by toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuoles, which are absent here.
Chédiak-Higashi granules are giant, dense azurophilic/peroxidase-positive granules rather than pale blue-gray patches.

3170.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中絕大多數紅血球失去中央淡染區、較緻密，表面伸出數目不等、長短不一且分布不規則的尖刺，這是棘狀紅血球（acanthocyte）增多。
features: Majority of red cells are dense, lacking central pallor, with irregularly spaced spicules
Spicules vary in length and thickness, some with knob-like ends
Admixed small spherocytic-appearing cells without projections
Single neutrophil with a lobulated nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm
Platelets present but sparse
3170.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of red cells that are dense and lack central pallor, bearing a variable number of irregularly distributed spicules of unequal length. Occasional small dense round cells without projections are also present. A neutrophil and rare platelets are seen. Findings are consistent with marked acanthocytosis; clinical correlation for abetalipoproteinemia, neuroacanthocytosis, severe liver disease (spur cell anemia) or McLeod phenotype is suggested.

ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, evenly spaced, regular projections and retain central pallor, often as a drying artifact or in uremia, whereas acanthocytes have fewer irregular spicules.
Keratocytes have one or two horn-like projections flanking a ruptured vacuole, reflecting microangiopathic injury, not multiple irregular spicules.
Spherocytes are small dense cells without projections, while acanthocytes, although dense, bear irregular spiky extensions.

3106.recognize_zh: 中型細胞，核有凹陷摺痕、染色質疏鬆呈網狀，周圍有一圈灰藍色胞質，形態雖較小但仍符合單核球。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cell, slightly smaller than a typical monocyte
Indented, folded nucleus with loose lacy chromatin
No nucleoli
Moderate rim of gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granularity
Occasional platelets nearby
3106.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized mononuclear cell with an indented, folded nucleus and loose, lacy chromatin without nucleoli. The cytoplasm forms a moderate gray-blue rim with fine granularity. Findings are consistent with a mature monocyte, a smaller variant with less abundant cytoplasm.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a round nucleus with denser clumped chromatin and clear or deep-blue cytoplasm rather than gray ground-glass cytoplasm.
Buttock cells are smaller with a sharp nuclear cleft, condensed chromatin, and scant cytoplasm.
Myelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with coarser chromatin and pink-lilac secondary granules.

2978.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高、組織鬆散，可見巨核細胞、紅血球母細胞群與散在細胞質豐富的組織球樣細胞，部分似含紅血球；噬血現象在切片上不易確認，需搭配抹片或 CD163 染色。
features: Hypercellular marrow with loose, edematous architecture
Megakaryocyte and clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Scattered histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, some possibly containing red cells
Occasional mitotic figure
Interstitial red cell extravasation
2978.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a loose, edematous background and interstitial hemorrhage. Megakaryocytes, erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells are present, together with scattered histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, some of which appear to contain erythrocytes. Hemophagocytosis is difficult to confirm on H&E sections. Findings may be compatible with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate context; CD163 immunostain and aspirate review are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow lacks increased histiocytes with engulfed cells; CD163 highlights the histiocytic expansion in HLH.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by lymphoma (e.g., T-cell lymphoma triggering HLH)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows atypical lymphoid aggregates or interstitial atypical cells confirmed by IHC and clonality studies.
MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and abnormal localization of precursors without histiocytic proliferation.

2786.recognize_zh: 這顆顆粒球比一般嗜中性球大，細胞核分成約 8–10 個以上擠在一起的葉（hypersegmentation），細胞質有細小中性顆粒；巨大且過度分葉的嗜中性球屬於顆粒球異常形態，常見於巨母紅血球性貧血、G-CSF 或藥物影響。
features: Enlarged neutrophil (macropolycyte), roughly 1.5-2 times the diameter of adjacent red cells
Markedly hypersegmented nucleus with numerous (well over 6) clustered lobes
Coarse, clumped mature chromatin in each lobe
Cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granulation, no toxic granulation or Dohle bodies evident
Background red cells show mild anisocytosis without obvious schistocytes
2786.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged neutrophil with a markedly hypersegmented nucleus composed of numerous clustered lobes of mature, clumped chromatin, and cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules. Adjacent red cells show mild anisocytosis. Giant hypersegmented neutrophils (macropolycytes) are a dysplastic-appearing granulocyte change that is most often reactive or nutritional, as seen with vitamin B12/folate deficiency, antimetabolite therapy (e.g., methotrexate, hydroxyurea) or growth factor exposure. Findings are consistent with a dysplastic (hypersegmented, giant) granulocyte; clinical correlation, B12/folate levels and medication history are recommended before attributing it to a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows the same hypersegmented neutrophils together with macro-ovalocytes and low B12/folate; the neutrophil alone cannot separate it from drug effect.
MDS more typically shows hypogranular or pseudo-Pelger-Huet hyposegmented neutrophils with cytopenias and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, rather than isolated hypersegmentation.
The hereditary form affects most neutrophils in an otherwise healthy person without macrocytosis, whereas acquired forms occur with nutritional deficiency or drugs.

2722.recognize_zh: 高倍下這顆淋巴球細胞質豐富、淡藍，核呈腎形凹陷，凹陷處的細胞質中聚集數顆粗大紫紅色嗜天青顆粒——典型大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Large lymphocyte about twice a red cell diameter with low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Indented (reniform) nucleus with coarsely condensed chromatin, no nucleoli
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with slightly irregular outline
Cluster of coarse azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm adjacent to the nuclear indentation
Adjacent platelets and normochromic red cells in background
2722.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a large lymphocyte with an indented nucleus, mature coarsely condensed chromatin and no visible nucleoli. The cytoplasm is abundant and pale blue and contains a small cluster of coarse azurophilic granules near the nuclear notch. Surrounding red cells are normochromic and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with a large granular lymphocyte, the morphologic correlate of NK-cell (or T-LGL) lymphocytosis; flow cytometry is required to assign lineage.

ddx.vs: Identical cytology; distinguished only by immunophenotype (surface CD3+, TCR alpha-beta) and clonal TCR rearrangement.
Monocytes have lacy, less condensed chromatin, folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles rather than a few coarse discrete granules.
Reactive lymphocytes have more basophilic cytoplasm that deepens toward the edges and wraps red cells, usually without azurophilic granules.

2594.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中單一母細胞，核偏位且一側凹陷，染色質細緻，細胞質中等量淡藍色，核旁有淡染區並帶少量淡粉紅顆粒，符合t(8;21) AML常見帶核周空暈的骨髓母細胞；是否有細長Auer小體在此解析度下無法確定。
features: Single blast about twice the size of a red cell
Eccentric nucleus with an indentation on the side facing the cytoplasm
Fine, finely granular chromatin with a faint small nucleolus
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with a paler paranuclear zone
Few faint pinkish granules; a delicate Auer rod cannot be confirmed
Thick area of smear with overlapping, stacked red cells
2594.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with overlapping red cells, shows a single blast with an eccentric, indented nucleus, finely granular chromatin, a faint nucleolus and a moderate amount of pale-blue cytoplasm. A paler paranuclear region containing a few faint pink granules is present adjacent to the nuclear indentation; a slender Auer rod cannot be confidently identified at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a myeloblast of the type seen in AML with t(8;21); confirmation of RUNX1::RUNX1T1 is required.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles and a delicately folded nucleus, and are nonspecific esterase positive rather than strongly MPO positive.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells with peripheral basophilia, without a paranuclear hof containing granules.
Plasma cells show coarse clock-face chromatin and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm despite the similar perinuclear clearing.

2402.recognize_zh: 高倍下可見早幼粒細胞（核圓、有核仁、顆粒細胞質並有核周淡區）、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞到桿狀核嗜中性球一路成熟，細胞形態正常無發育異常，符合恢復中骨髓的顆粒球再生。
features: Promyelocytes with round nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and granular basophilic cytoplasm with paranuclear hof
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with progressively condensed, indented nuclei and pink granular cytoplasm
Numerous band neutrophils with normal granulation
Scattered erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes
Smudged/crushed cells at upper left (smear artifact); no Auer rods or dysplasia evident
2402.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a spectrum of granulocytic precursors, including promyelocytes with round nuclei, visible nucleoli, and granular cytoplasm with paranuclear hofs, along with myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and numerous band neutrophils. Granulation and nuclear segmentation appear normal, and no Auer rods or dysplastic changes are identified. Occasional erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are present, with smudged cells at the upper left. Findings are consistent with active granulocytic regeneration in a recovering bone marrow.

ddx.vs: APL promyelocytes are atypical with folded nuclei, heavy granules or Auer rod bundles and fail to mature, while here promyelocytes mature normally to bands.
AML with maturation has ≥20% blasts with dysplastic maturing cells, whereas this field shows orderly maturation without increased blasts.
MDS shows hypogranular, hypolobated (pseudo-Pelger) neutrophils and dysplastic erythroids or megakaryocytes, which are absent here.

2018.recognize_zh: 淋巴結中倍 H&E：中央一大片較淡染的區域，細胞質較多、排列較鬆散，推測是竇內單核樣 B 細胞增生（monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia），邊緣另有小團粉紅色類上皮組織球；這是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎三聯徵之一。
features: Lymph node with dense small lymphocytes at the periphery of the field
Central pale zone of cells with more abundant cytoplasm, suggestive of sinusoidal monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia
Small pink clusters of epithelioid histiocytes at the margins of the pale zone
Streaming, sinus-like arrangement of the pale cells
No necrosis or multinucleated giant cells
Cytologic detail of individual cells limited at this magnification
2018.describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at intermediate power shows a central pale zone composed of loosely arranged cells with more abundant cytoplasm in a sinus-like distribution, surrounded by dense small lymphocytes. Small clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are present at the margins. Necrosis and giant cells are absent. At this magnification the pale cells cannot be definitively typed, but the pattern is most suggestive of monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia, consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma shows confluent sheets of monocytoid cells effacing the architecture with light chain restriction, rather than sinusoidal expansion within a reactive node.
Sinus histiocytosis consists of histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei (CD68+), whereas monocytoid B cells have clear cytoplasm and are CD20+.
Cat-scratch disease also has monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia but develops stellate suppurative necrotizing granulomas with neutrophils.

1954.recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被小至中型淋巴球的密集浸潤取代，中央有一條管壁嗜酸性玻璃樣化的分支血管，血管周圍與左上方聚集胞質淡染/透明的中型細胞，呈現 AITL 的血管周圍透明細胞型態。
features: Diffuse dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei
Branching vessel with eosinophilic hyalinized wall and plump endothelium crossing the center
Clusters of medium-sized cells with pale to clear cytoplasm, particularly around the vessel and at upper left
Additional thin-walled vessels in the background; follicles not identified
Fibrous tissue at the lower right corner
1954.describe_en: Lymph node section shows diffuse effacement by a dense infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei. A branching high endothelial venule with a hyalinized eosinophilic wall traverses the field, and clusters of medium-sized cells with pale to clear cytoplasm are present around it and in the upper left. No follicles are identified. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; TFH markers and CD21 staining are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks perivascular clusters of TFH-phenotype clear cells and expanded perivascular FDC meshworks.
Nodal MZL also has pale monocytoid cells but these are CD20-positive B cells surrounding residual follicles rather than PD-1/CD10-positive T cells.
Reactive paracortex preserves follicles and sinuses and lacks atypical clear cell clusters and T-cell clonality.

1762.recognize_zh: 組織切片中大型多形性腫瘤細胞與大量中性球、少量嗜酸性球混雜，中央可見大型異常核分裂，大細胞核呈不規則或腎形、核仁明顯，符合富含中性球的間變性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with vesicular, irregular to reniform nuclei and visible nucleoli
Numerous admixed neutrophils with segmented nuclei and scattered eosinophils
Large atypical mitotic figure near the center
Moderate amounts of pale amphophilic cytoplasm
No preserved nodal architecture in this field
1762.describe_en: Tissue section shows a diffuse infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells with irregular to kidney-shaped vesicular nuclei, visible nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, admixed with abundant neutrophils and scattered eosinophils. An atypical mitotic figure is present. The dense neutrophilic component can obscure the neoplastic cells and suggest an abscess or inflammatory process. Findings are consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, neutrophil-rich pattern; CD30 and ALK immunostains are recommended to highlight the tumor cells.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, mixed cellularity or syncytial variant
ddx.vs: Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg cells with macronucleoli in a lymphocyte- and eosinophil-rich background and is CD15+, weak PAX5+, and ALK negative.
Reactive inflammation lacks sheets of cytologically atypical large cells and atypical mitoses.
PTCL-NOS shows a range of atypical T cells without uniform strong CD30 and hallmark cells, and is ALK negative.

1698.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見兩顆母細胞：核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少且偏藍，無顆粒或 Auer 小體；單看型態只能判斷為急性白血病，雙表型（biphenotypic）需靠流式細胞儀確認。
features: Two circulating blasts of medium to large size with high N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Scant basophilic cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
One blast smaller and more densely stained than the other
Background red cells with drying-artifact central clearing; image resolution is low
1698.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin and scant basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods are not identified. Red cells show refractile drying artifact. The morphology is that of an acute leukemia but is not lineage-specific; the low image resolution also limits assessment of nucleoli. Assignment as mixed-phenotype (biphenotypic) acute leukemia requires flow cytometric demonstration of lineage-defining markers (e.g., MPO plus CD19 with strong CD79a/CD22/CD10).

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation depends on the absence of myeloid-defining markers such as MPO on flow cytometry.
Also agranular without Auer rods; it lacks strong B- or T-lineage-defining markers on immunophenotyping.

ddx.dx: Reactive large granular or activated lymphocyte
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm and condensed chromatin rather than the fine blastic chromatin seen here.

1634.recognize_zh: 淋巴組織中央有一片較淡染的區域，由核較大、染色質較開放、細胞質淡粉紅的中型細胞組成，中間可見一個含兩顆凋亡小體的空暈細胞，周圍被深染小淋巴球包圍，屬正常淋巴組織中的淡染結節（副皮質或生發中心）。
features: Central pale zone of medium-sized cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Surrounding small lymphocytes with round dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
A macrophage with a clear halo containing apoptotic nuclear debris near the center
Small vessels with red cells at the periphery
Mixed population without cytologic atypia or sheets of large cells
1634.describe_en: Section of lymphoid tissue at high power shows a pale-staining nodular zone composed of medium-sized cells with vesicular, round to oval nuclei and moderate pale cytoplasm, surrounded by dense small lymphocytes. A macrophage containing apoptotic debris and small vessels are present. The exact compartment (paracortical nodule versus germinal center) cannot be assigned from this single field without immunostains. Findings are consistent with normal/reactive lymphoid tissue.

ddx.vs: Proliferation centers contain prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts in a diffusely effaced node of small round lymphocytes, typically without tingible body macrophages.
NLPHL shows large vaguely nodular areas containing large multilobated LP cells, which are not identified here.
Monocytoid B cells cluster in perisinusoidal areas and have more abundant clear cytoplasm and distinct cell borders with admixed neutrophils.

61858.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆明顯大於周圍血小板、接近紅血球大小的顆粒狀紫色物體，中心顆粒集中、邊緣淡而有突起，是大型／巨大血小板（giant platelet）。
features: Central platelet markedly larger than surrounding platelets, approaching the diameter of adjacent red cells
Central concentration of purple granules (granulomere) with a paler, finely fimbriated peripheral hyalomere
Several other scattered platelets, some also enlarged with visible granules
An ovoid pale lilac structure at the top of the field, possibly another large platelet seen en face
Background normocytic red cells with occasional target-like forms; no leukocytes in field
61858.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with occasional target-like forms and scattered platelets of variable size. In the center is a platelet approaching the size of an adjacent red cell, with centrally clustered purple granules and a pale, irregular peripheral rim. Several other platelets are also larger than normal. No platelet clumps or leukocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with large to giant platelets; correlation with platelet count and clinical context (increased turnover, myeloid neoplasm or inherited macrothrombocytopenia) is needed.

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a dense round nucleus with a rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas a platelet is anucleate with granular purple center and pale hyalomere.
Overlap produces a normal-sized platelet superimposed on a red cell in the same focal plane, not a free-standing enlarged platelet.
Megakaryocyte nuclei or nuclear fragments show dense chromatin, which is absent in this anucleate platelet.

63138.recognize_zh: S-100 在大型組織球的細胞核與豐富細胞質強烈陽性，而箭頭所指的是被包入組織球細胞質中、呈淡色未染的完整淋巴球（細胞穿入現象 emperipolesis），陰性輪廓在棕色背景中特別明顯，這是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的典型表現。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm showing strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S-100 positivity
Intact S-100-negative lymphocytes/inflammatory cells within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis, arrows)
Histiocyte nuclei round to oval, vesicular, with small nucleoli
Background of fibrous stroma with spindle cells and interspersed small lymphoid cells lacking staining
63138.describe_en: S-100 immunohistochemistry highlights numerous large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm and strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining. Within the cytoplasm of several histiocytes, intact unstained lymphocytes are seen (arrows), representing emperipolesis, which is accentuated by the negative outline against the S-100-positive cytoplasm. The background shows fibrous stroma with spindle cells and scattered inflammatory cells. Findings are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are smaller with grooved, reniform nuclei, co-express CD1a and langerin, and lack emperipolesis.
ECD shows foamy histiocytes with Touton giant cells that are usually S-100-negative (or weak), without emperipolesis, and often BRAF V600E-positive.
Reactive histiocytes are S-100-negative and do not show prominent emperipolesis.
IgG4-RD shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis and increased IgG4+ plasma cells without S-100-positive emperipolesis-rich histiocytes, although RDD may have increased IgG4 cells.
