62946.recognize_zh: CD20 只標出散在、單個分布的大型非典型細胞（膜狀棕色、核大而空泡狀），周圍大量小淋巴球與組織球皆不染；少數腫瘤性大 B 細胞散布在豐富的非腫瘤背景中，正是富含 T 細胞/組織球大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（THRLBCL）的樣貌。
features: Scattered, individually dispersed large atypical cells with strong membranous CD20 staining
Large cells with vesicular nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, several times the size of background lymphocytes
Abundant background of CD20-negative small lymphocytes and elongated histiocyte/endothelial nuclei
No CD20-positive small B-cell nodules or meshwork in this field
Some granular CD20 debris around positive cells; mitosis not clearly resolvable at this resolution
62946.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows scattered, singly dispersed large atypical lymphoid cells with strong membranous staining, set within an abundant CD20-negative background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes. The positive cells have enlarged vesicular nuclei and do not form sheets or cohesive clusters, and no background nodules of small B cells are seen in this field. The findings support B-cell lineage of the large atypical cells and, in the context of a T-cell- and histiocyte-rich background, are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL retains at least a focal nodular pattern with a CD20-positive small B-cell meshwork and PD-1+ T-cell rosettes around LP cells, whereas THRLBCL lacks residual small B-cell nodules.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15-positive with weak PAX5 and usually absent or heterogeneous CD20, rather than uniform strong CD20 with CD30 negativity.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with large B-cell blasts (e.g., angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: AITL has atypical CD3+/PD-1+/CD10+ T cells with expanded CD21 FDC meshworks and often EBV+ B blasts, whereas here the background T cells are non-neoplastic.
Reactive immunoblasts are a mix of B and T cells, lack atypia and occur alongside preserved follicles.

62434.recognize_zh: 大片中等大小、單調一致、核圓且可見小核仁的腫瘤細胞，BCL2 完全不染，只有少數散在的小型反應性 T 細胞呈棕色膜狀／細胞質陽性當作內部對照；BCL2 陰性支持 Burkitt 淋巴瘤，而非 BCL2 陽性的高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei and small nucleoli
Neoplastic cells negative for BCL2
Rare scattered small positive cells (reactive T cells) providing an internal positive control
Cohesive-appearing sheet with squared-off cell borders; tingible-body macrophages not clearly highlighted
62434.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei and small nucleoli that are entirely negative for BCL2. Rare scattered small reactive lymphocytes show cytoplasmic staining and serve as an internal positive control. Absence of BCL2 in the neoplastic cells, together with a CD10+, BCL6+ phenotype, Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement, supports Burkitt lymphoma. Findings are consistent with Burkitt lymphoma.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Double-hit lymphoma usually shows strong BCL2 expression and requires FISH for BCL2 rearrangement, while Burkitt lymphoma is BCL2-negative or only weak.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, germinal center type
ddx.vs: DLBCL has larger, more pleomorphic cells, often BCL2-positive, with Ki-67 generally below 90%.
Lymphoblasts have finer chromatin, are TdT/CD34-positive and surface immunoglobulin-negative, and lack MYC::IG rearrangement.
Blastoid MCL is CD5-positive, BCL2-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.

64994.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片中度倍率下，腎實質幾乎被瀰漫的小淋巴樣細胞浸潤取代，只剩散在的血管，看不到明確的腎小管或腎絲球；此視野未見明顯濾泡結構，濾泡性淋巴瘤的診斷需靠免疫染色佐證。
features: Diffuse, dense infiltrate of small lymphoid cells effacing renal parenchyma
Small cells with round to slightly irregular dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Residual thick-walled vessels, including a larger congested vessel at the top
No clearly recognizable tubules or glomeruli in this field
No well-formed follicular (nodular) pattern discernible at this magnification
Pale, faded staining limits cytologic detail
64994.describe_en: H&E-stained renal biopsy at intermediate power shows effacement of the renal parenchyma by a dense, diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm, with only residual interspersed blood vessels and no clearly preserved tubules or glomeruli. A follicular growth pattern is not evident in this field, and image quality limits assessment of centrocytes versus centroblasts. The infiltrate is monotonous without a prominent mixed inflammatory component. Findings are consistent with renal involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD10, BCL6, BCL2) is needed to support follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Interstitial nephritis contains a mixed infiltrate with plasma cells, eosinophils, and tubulitis while preserving tubules, rather than monotonous effacement.
CLL/SLL shows proliferation centers and is CD5+/CD23+, whereas follicular lymphoma is CD10+/BCL6+ with BCL2 and t(14;18).
MZL cells often have more pale cytoplasm with plasmacytic differentiation and are CD10- and BCL6-.
PTLD occurs in transplant recipients, is often polymorphous with plasma cells and immunoblasts, and is frequently EBER positive.

60706.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片（cytospin）中可見偏心核、核周淡染區（hof）及嗜鹼性細胞質的漿細胞，部分為雙核並帶核內淡染包涵體（箭頭）；下方 B–F 依序呈現前期、中期（極面觀與側面觀）、後期到末期的有絲分裂，表示腦脊髓液中的骨髓瘤細胞仍在增殖。
features: Panel A: CSF cytospin with a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin and paranuclear hof
Abundant basophilic cytoplasm with ruffled borders; binucleate cells with pale intranuclear inclusions (arrows)
Panels B–F: plasma cells in successive mitotic stages (prophase/prometaphase, metaphase in polar and side view, anaphase, telophase)
Atypical features including nucleoli and multinucleation support neoplastic rather than reactive plasma cells
Clean background without significant inflammatory cells or red cells
60706.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, paranuclear clearing, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm with ruffled borders (A). Atypical forms include binucleate cells and nuclei with pale intranuclear inclusions (arrows). Panels B through F display plasma cells in sequential stages of mitosis, from prophase/prometaphase through metaphase, anaphase, and telophase, indicating active proliferation. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by plasma cell myeloma; confirmation of clonality by flow cytometry or light-chain restriction is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are few, cytologically bland, polytypic, and accompanied by lymphocytes, whereas myelomatous involvement shows atypical, mitotically active, light-chain–restricted plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation (e.g., lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, Bing-Neel syndrome)
ddx.vs: LPL/Bing-Neel shows a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than a pure atypical plasma cell population.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has large immunoblastic cells with prominent central nucleoli, is often EBER-positive and HIV-associated, and lacks a history of myeloma.
